inline_text: aaif/wg-observability-and-traceability#75 records an accountability check at one hop. Continuity of the same principal across hops needs evidence telemetry cannot carry: a trace value linking two hops would be a correlation handle. The attributes can carry a reference to such evidence but cannot define it (open question 5). Could Identity & Trust own a document on delegation evidence across hops, covering what each hop verifies back to an accountable root and how a mapping is recorded where an identifier is translated at a trust boundary?
